guidance.text: Do not assume the coverage gap can be closed by appending a scope line to .pinker/cartography/coverage-policy-v1.jsonl. src/nav_coverage.rs refuses at load time with E-COVERAGE-POLICY-ROOTS ('escopos declarados nao cobrem exatamente as raizes oficiais') and E-COVERAGE-POLICY-SCOPE-CONTRACT ('o nivel de obrigacao de uma raiz nao e declaravel na autoridade'), and ROOT_CONTRACT fails closed for an official root with no code contract. Bringing a new root in means mutating official_scan_roots(), ROOT_CONTRACT, the policy JSONL and the tests that fix the root list as a code contract, then resynchronizing the catalog over a larger scanned universe — which is the class of change that puts the 13 FROZEN projections at risk. Before designing such a placement, check whether the current Task actually holds authority over the cartography-root surface; if it does not, the honest terminal is a delivery-constraint block that returns the root decision to the Guide, not a transparently reported gap. A declared gap does not return the gate to green. What U-08 established is the shape of the Guide's answer when the decision comes back: the unit may proceed with the crate in the sibling form provided the unvalidated status is stated in the source, asserted by a test that refuses to claim coverage, and tracked by the open policy Issue (#709). Write EXPLICITLY_UNVALIDATED_BY_CURRENT_COVERAGE as a fact of the delivery, never as 'covered'; the two are not the same and rewriting one as the other is the failure this case exists to prevent.

observed_result.text: At main 73e518bac30474dc8b7eb87e1d6bc3a957400095: pink nav cobertura reports apps 1/1, runtime/pinker_rt/src 1/1, src 117/117, tests inventory, lacunas=0, rc=0, and zero rows for the four contract crates; grep finds 8 @pinker-nav:start markers in them (argv 1, json 5, memory 1, sha256 1), matching HD-04's historical count exactly; pink nav mostrar runtime.memoria.contrato-publico does not resolve. The gate is green while 8 regions of shared authority are unmeasured. RESOLUTION OBSERVED (U-08, PR #710, main d066563dca978d90e846ca5a7f46b20f459ba3a0, postmerge CI run 35478568229 SUCCESS): the fifth crate runtime/pinker_verso_contract was placed in exactly this form and the predicted invisibility held — pink nav cobertura at the merged head still emits zero rows for it while reporting the four official roots with lacunas=0 and rc=0. The Guide's accepted disposition was neither to widen the roots nor to hide the gap: the crate carries its @pinker-nav region for consistency with its siblings, its own doc comment and the LAW-08 test state EXPLICITLY_UNVALIDATED_BY_CURRENT_COVERAGE != COVERED in the source itself, a test (cobertura_nao_e_reivindicada_para_o_crate_de_contrato) asserts that the unit claims no coverage it did not measure, and the cartography-policy debt stays with #709, which remained OPEN and unauthorized through the whole unit. A unit blocked by this case can therefore proceed: declaring the authority unvalidated and tracking it separately is an accepted terminal, distinct from both a silent gap and a root mutation.

problem.text: official_scan_roots() in src/nav.rs declares exactly [src, runtime/pinker_rt/src, tests, apps]. It is the single source for both the Trama catalog (pink nav sincronizar/verificar) and, through ROOT_CONTRACT plus .pinker/cartography/coverage-policy-v1.jsonl, for pink nav cobertura. The four existing shared contract crates live at runtime/pinker_argv_contract, runtime/pinker_json_contract, runtime/pinker_memory_contract and runtime/pinker_sha256_contract, i.e. outside every root. They carry 8 @pinker-nav:start markers that are absent from the catalog: pink nav mostrar runtime.memoria.contrato-publico answers 'chave de codigo nao encontrada' while the marker is physically present at runtime/pinker_memory_contract/src/lib.rs:7, and pink nav cobertura returns no row for any of the four. A fifth crate placed in the same form inherits the same invisibility: the new authority is unvalidated by construction, not by omission.
